desc: Arrangement model established: answer = min over permutations of (equal-value runs + inversions); equivalently assign each maximal run a level (same level ⇒ same value), cost = #levels + Σ_{i<j, level_i>level_j} len_i*len_j.
Old unweighted solution shown incorrect (ignores run lengths).
Weighted run-length caching greedy implemented and passes all 3 public samples (3, 4, 8).
Exhaustively brute-force validated the greedy vs exact BFS/Dijkstra for all small arrays (N≤8 alphabet 3, N≤7 alphabet 4); zero mismatches.
Cross-checked against the `R - max good pairs` formula and the w*L==1 tie-break variant; greedy confirmed correct.
Finalized submission: fast I/O, reads T cases, outputs numeric answers only; verified samples plus edge cases (all equal → 1, all distinct → N).
